name: Suffolk
appliesTo: The school term dates for all Suffolk County Council's maintained schools for the 2026/2027 school year. All term dates for community and voluntary controlled schools are on the county council's website.
academyNote: Academies, voluntary aided and free schools can set their own term dates so please check with your child's school in case these differ from those set by us.

localFacts.fact: Suffolk calls teacher training days Professional Development (PD) days; every maintained school sets five of them.
The county council recommends PD days for 2026-27: Tuesday 1 and Wednesday 2 September 2026, Friday 23 October 2026, Monday 4 January 2027 and Monday 12 April 2027.
Most schools in Suffolk follow the recommended PD days, but the council asks parents to contact their school to confirm.
For 2027-28 the recommended PD days are 1, 2 and 3 September 2027, Tuesday 4 January 2028 and Tuesday 18 April 2028, so the year opens with three training days.
The school year totals 195 days, giving 190 teaching days once the five PD days are taken.
The council's 2027-28 PDF gives the Easter holiday as starting on Friday 31 March 2028, the same day it lists as the end of spring term; the web page gives Saturday 1 April 2028.

2026-27.insetNote: All maintained schools set five Professional Development (PD) days. The council recommends Tuesday 1 and Wednesday 2 September 2026, Friday 23 October 2026, Monday 4 January 2027 and Monday 12 April 2027; most schools follow these.
2026-27.notes: 195 days in total, 190 teaching days after the five PD days.

2027-28.insetNote: Schools set five PD days. The council recommends Wednesday 1, Thursday 2 and Friday 3 September 2027, Tuesday 4 January 2028 and Tuesday 18 April 2028 (the PDF prints 'Tuesday 2' September).
2027-28.notes: Spring term ends Friday 31 March 2028; Easter holiday taken from the web page (Saturday 1 April to Monday 17 April 2028), the PDF says Friday 31 March. Summer term ends Friday 21 July 2028.
